Radial orthogonality does not imply dual 1-conformal flatness — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date and Zenodo publication: 2026-09-26. Explicit negative answer to Kurose’s printed Question 3(e): S²(1) × R with its Levi–Civita connection has integrable radial distributions but its dual is nowhere locally 1-conformally flat. Includes a non-self-dual example and n≥3 extension. Four-page unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint; two fresh adversarial AI reviews found no actionable issues. Exact and 403-check symbolic verifiers included. Historical priority unresolved; no first-resolution claim. Paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/radial-statistical-counterexample/

Nonattainment in the Harrell–Stubbe Dirichlet gap inequality — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Three-page AI-assisted, unrefereed preprint; two fresh adversarial reviews found no actionable issues. Includes source/priority audits and a verifier with 7,016 exact checks. Public record: https://zenodo.org/records/22983513 ; paper and materials: https://aleckriebel.github.io/Math/papers/strict-dirichlet-gap/

Irreducibility of exposed-point varieties of discotopes — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X), v1.0, 30 September 2026. Full resolution of Meroni’s 2023 exposed-point conjecture: complex Zariski closure is irreducible for every finite sum of ellipsoidal discs of ranks at least two, without genericity or full dimensionality. A separate general-position theorem identifies it with the purely nonlinear part, resolving Gesmundo–Meroni’s 2022 generic conjecture. Earlier partial results and the standard analytic lemma are credited; no historical first-priority claim. Exact checks reproduced, extensive independent AI mathematical/priority audits and two fresh full-package review rounds completed, with all findings resolved. Unrefereed; extensive generative-AI use disclosed; no human peer review or formal certification claimed. PDF plus source/verification/review archive; prose CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Primary problem source: https://doi.org/10.4171/OWR/2023/15, p.830, Conjecture 1. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23074543. Reviewed PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/9.
